note: Issuer fixed-value redemptions for US Membership Rewards and Ultimate Rewards (#307). centsPerPoint is a number only when an official page or term states it; null means the value is unknown, "varies" means the issuer says it differs by card or condition. Transfers live in rules.json.

sources.title: Chase · Sapphire Preferred with Ultimate Rewards Program Agreement
American Express · Membership Rewards Program Terms and Conditions (US)

redemptions.textEn: If you're interested in cash back, each point is worth 1 cent when redeemed.
redemptions.textZh: 兑换现金返还（账单抵扣或存入 Chase 账户）时，每点值 1 美分。

redemptions.textEn: The point value is 1 cent when redeeming for gift cards. Chase sometimes discounts certain gift cards, which raises the value on those cards.
redemptions.textZh: 兑换礼品卡时每点值 1 美分；Chase 有时对部分礼品卡打折，该卡的实际价值会更高。

redemptions.textEn: Points may have higher value when redeemed for travel through Chase Travel; Points Boost makes them worth up to 50% more with eligible Chase cards, and the boost varies by card.
redemptions.textZh: 通过 Chase Travel 订旅行时价值可能更高；Points Boost 在符合条件的 Chase 卡上最高多 50%，具体倍数因卡而异，页面未给出固定数字。

redemptions.textEn: Choose to receive a statement credit on one or more of your eligible purchases.
redemptions.textZh: 选择对一笔或多笔符合条件的消费换成账单抵扣；页面未给出每点价值。
redemptions.unknownReason: Tried on 2026-11-17, no value per point found. redemptions.textEn: American Express Business Checking Account with a linked Business Platinum Card = 1,000 points for a $10 deposit up to the first 1,000,000 points per calendar year, then 1,000 points for an $8 deposit.
redemptions.textZh: 美国 Business Checking 账户且关联 Business Platinum 卡：每年前 100 万点按 1,000 点兑 10 美元存入，超出部分按 1,000 点兑 8 美元。

redemptions.textEn: American Express Business Checking Account or Rewards Checking Account (including Checking Accounts linked to other Cards) = 1,000 points for an $8 deposit.
redemptions.textZh: Business Checking 或 Rewards Checking 账户（含关联其他卡的）：1,000 点兑 8 美元存入。

redemptions.textEn: You must redeem points worth at least $1 to Use Points for a Statement Credit. The value of points varies according to how you choose to use them.
